test_title: PYST 46: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. A sits second to the left of D. B sits to the immediate right of F. E sits second to the left of C. How many people sit between D and B?
solution:
Given: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of C.

E sits second to the left of C.

A sits second to the left of D.

B sits to the immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f63f11e57a1800f062acf595b09ce6470f757e6a8a860f5681439827fbdf8934.png] 

So, there are 2 people between D and B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
